reasonableness.draft_prompt: 2x4 overview strawberry soft candy same_object mother+parts white cards dark bg
reasonableness.revised_prompt:
Royal Match casual prop sheet. ONE image 16:9, exactly 2 rows × 4 columns equal rounded white glossy cards on charcoal dark-gray studio ground. Match spacing/card bevel/studio light of attached grid reference; do not copy instruments.

Surface lock: 软塑胶圆润厚实体 + 白圆角卡 + 深灰底棚光. Medium: translucent strawberry soft candy gummy with SSS半透明软糖 soft jelly squish wide soft specular; 禁止硬塑胶 / 禁止抛光塑料玩具感.

same_object: 每档仍是同一母体+零件. base_body 草莓软糖 retained every cell as single centered item. Crowns/ribbons/wrap/stars are 母体上的配件 only. 禁止礼盒当格内主体. 禁止奖杯当格内主体. No faces, no level numbers, no text.

Row1 L→R:
L1 裸草莓软糖: round translucent red strawberry soft candy alone, no leaves, ~58% card.
L2 带蒂草莓软糖: same strawberry soft candy + green soft-plastic calyx leaves welded on top.
L3 糖纸草莓软糖: same strawberry soft candy in translucent twisted candy paper both ends; gummy readable through wrap.
L4 彩带草莓软糖: same strawberry soft candy with thin pink ribbon bow at waist.
